mcqs.question: As of 19 March 2026, how many rooftop solar systems had been installed under the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana?
mcqs.explanation: The PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana had installed more than 26.19 lakh rooftop systems by 19 March 2026. The figures 2.7 GW and 26.75 GW refer to capacity, while 1 crore households is the scheme’s target for 2026–27.
